message.content:
In Blackjack, an Ace is a “soft” card because it can be counted as either **1** or **11**, depending on which value gives the best advantage without busting.  

- If counting the Ace as 11 keeps your total ≤ 21, you’ll usually treat it as 11.  
- If adding 11 would bust you, you treat it as 1.  

If you have two Aces, one will normally be counted as 11 and the other as 1 (so you’re at 12), unless you’re playing a variation where a pair of Aces can be split. This flexibility is what makes Aces so valuable in Blackjack.
